description: Jobs — Returns aggregate job-market statistics from Worklittle. Call with no args for the full indexed market (counts, workplace mix, top hiring companies). When the user names a role and/or city (e.g. product managers in San Francisco), pass query and location. The filtered slice includes match count, top companies in the sample, and salary signals from listings that publish pay.

location.description: Location substring for a market slice (e.g. San Francisco).

query.description: Role or title filter for a market slice (e.g. product manager).

workplace_type.description: Optional workplace filter for the slice.

name: get_market_overview

outputSchema.description: Aggregate job market stats for the requested filters.

title: Jobs · Get Market Overview
